headline: One Man's Mission: Replacing Every Missing Basketball Net in NYC
meta_description: Craig Campanella has made it his mission to ensure every basketball hoop in New York City has a net, one court at a time.
summary_short: Craig Campanella is on a mission to repair and restore basketball hoops across New York City, making sure every court has a proper net.
body:
Craig Campanella has made it his mission to ensure that every basketball hoop in New York City has a net. What began as a personal observation—noticing countless hoops stripped of their nets across the city's neighborhoods—has become a dedicated effort to restore these community spaces.

Campanella's work addresses a simple but overlooked problem: missing nets can discourage young players from practicing their craft and signal neglect in public spaces. By systematically replacing nets throughout NYC, he's restoring not just equipment, but also dignity and opportunity to neighborhood courts.

This grassroots initiative shows how one person's attention to detail can improve quality of life in a city. Each net Campanella installs represents a court ready to welcome players again—a small act with real impact on the communities where basketball remains a vital part of life.
quick_facts: Craig Campanella targets missing basketball nets across NYC
His mission focuses on restoring community court equipment
The effort addresses neglected public spaces citywide
